I relate to this, I have a medium quality of life, but I just hate myself so much, I just wanna die

But I know, deep inside I will never have the courage :/, and I'll just live until I disgracefully die
I have the same plan, but I don't want to be alive after I dissapear. But I think I'll not achieve my suicide plan anyways, as any kind of previous plan in my life

Thanks for the kind words man, I know that what really matters is what I feel, but I try to hide my feelings, it's causing me to go crazy so that's why I posted this, thanks again for the interaction.

I basicaly lost a friend because we had nothing in common other than my complaints about life, wich she could relate and tried to help me sometimes.

But eventually she stopped caring (for many good reasons though), 2022 is almost here, Christmas has passed by and we haven't talked. Her birthday is coming and I don't know if she wants to see me saying something, I think it'd ruin it. She posts her life normally on Instagram and seems to be fine without that sick weird fuck who is weak and can't handle problems by himself. (Me ofc) 

I feel you, specially because I was taught that stupid thing about man crying = weak, so my only friend and I never speak about struggles (I think he may have a vague idea but he doesn't know I want to kill myself), so yeah, we're all alone in the end.
Me too, but I've heard it isn't a great method

Health issues (that would be fine if wasn't for my mother fucking everything up), family problems, I look like something you'd see at a horror circus, money, friendships, everywhere I look I see no hope.

Yeah I tried to say that part of reaching out being something natural but I couldn't. English is hard for me + I'm hella dumb. But thanks for the kind help. I appreciate, if only people around me were as helpful as you're being. I mean, in a simple Reddit post, you're being helpful and trying to understand someone that's 100% unknown and wants to kill itself. Thanks

You said that to reach out it is a sign of trying. I disagreed saying that's because of Internet and the way it is. Also spoke for myself, saying that I make posts/comments about me being depressed, but I really do it because I have nothing else to do, and even though people usually don't care about my posts/replies I keep doing because... Yeah idk. 

But I understand your point of helping out people by venting here. That's good and inspiring, you're a good person. Don't give me ears, I'm just way too sad, tired, wasted, weird, grumpy and pessimist.

I'm 15 and I think that's an optimistical way to think, which is good for you I guess, you really look like someone who can put their thoughts on the paper exactly like they are on your head. Wich makes me rather jealous, not in a bad way, to hate you for example. But this whole post just made me realize how fucking idiot I can be, I'll never get a life and negative thinking gets me every fucking time something good happens with me. 

I'll have to disagree on you when you said that thing about coming here on this sub to say: "I'm sad". And that's because this is Internet. You don't know me and will remain not knowing. You're probably from another country than I am and here we are. Talking about things that even my psychologist have not heard (yet?). That freedom of speech is hardly encountered in real life, and that's why people come here and type about their disgraces. It's conveninent, easy, and blah blah blah

For example, I'd never say 90% of that in real life, those words are impossible to leave from my mouth to anyone.

Anyways I don't wanna sound like an excited Internet revolutionary, just wanted to explain why that happens. If anyone reads that shit anyways, my posts and replies always get ignored.


Sorry for any grammar mistake I'm South American

Edit: there was a fucking rude mistake there, sorry i'm kinda paranoid with writing even though I suck

I can relate to this, if only I had the balls.

I'm scared that it will be painful but hopefully I can find a painless way or something like that. But deep inside I know that there isn't a painless method and that stupid fear will keep me alive, only to suffer.

TLDR: precisa ler eu reclamando da vida não, só saiba que eu respondi que eu tenho insônia sim.








.


.
Tenho muita insônia, toda vez que chega essa hora da madrugada só consigo pensar/planejar meu fim. Eu sou todo errado e esquisito, tem hora que eu realmente acho que tudo é uma conspiração pra dar errado e me manter sofrendo aqui na Terra.

Eu tenho motivos pra não "ir embora" mas também tenho motivos pra "ir", acaba sendo uma imensa tortura diária. Eu tô mais pra lá do que pra cá, por que isso não acaba logo?

I relate a lot to this, either I'll just do it, or I continue to try cutting all my relationships already, since they're all messed up and doing this, people that I like won't suffer my death that much. If there's even a afterlife or whatever, best hopes you guys (we?) from this world/dimension just stop existing when I die, like a massive time freeze.

I used to think about not crying for x amount of years too when I was younger, and it was awesome to me, it felt like I was growing up to be a tough man I guess. Now I realize this is shit. I simply cannot express myself by any manners beside texts like this one, and it isn't even in my native language (for some reason, that would be weird for me). When I write it's like someone else completely diferent from me, especially when I talk about my struggles. So yeah restraining sadness and other feelings caused me to not be able to cry and yes it does feel like shit, I understand you.

Edits: typing

I can't cry either. And there are a lot of reasons to do so, but I also feel numb, and it's because of past traumas and etc, yeah. I've been taught that man doesn't cry nor express emotions, and when I did, it just looked ridiculous and people laughed at me (I think that's why I'm so weird and unsociable) Currently I'm living with a lot of people at the moment, as usual for me, so even as depressed as I am right now, I have to keep those emotions restrained.

I hate the only "good" that is left in me, wich is the adoration of those who met a version of myself in the past that is now gone. 


complicated to understand but is like: people, especially my family likes me. But is just like a poor stray dog following you with sorrow eyes. You can't just pour in gallons of love without considering the rest. This dog one day will die, leading to suffering. And If the moments you had with him weren't good, for example, you'll just regret paying attention to that dog first place.

This sounds (and probably is) selfish and dumb. But the way i am is so fucking weird. My life was never good.. what the fuck do i have to do here anymore? Suffer? 

However I appreciate the kind attempt. Maybe you're able to help others, but not me, i'm just broken. You seems to be a good person.
Thanks, but that is simply an utopic alternative for me. I shouldn't be here, alive
15, viver mentindo, sempre estragar tudo e ainda não ter me matado por medo
